title.purpose: Card-level headings: job titles, degree names.

body.purpose: All readable paragraphs, experience details, descriptions.

label.purpose: Tags, contact labels, company names, date badges, footer. The mechanical metadata voice.

shadows.name: forge-glow-hover
shadows.purpose: Deeper glow on print button hover.

components.name: Tag
components.description: Skill chip. Mono font, accent-soft background, accent text. Inverts on hover.
components.css: .ds-tag { display: inline-block; font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace; font-size: 0.8rem; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.05em; padding: 6px 13px; background: rgba(255, 107, 53, 0.15); color: #FF6B35; border: 1px solid rgba(255, 107, 53, 0.25); border-radius: 4px; transition: all 0.25s cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1); cursor: default; } .ds-tag:hover { background: #FF6B35; color: #0a0a0a; transform: translateY(-2px); }

components.name: Card
components.description: Content card for experience and education entries. Tonal surface with ghost border.
components.html:
Senior Frontend Developer

Birdeye
2023 — Present
components.css: .ds-card { background: #141414; border: 1px solid rgba(245, 245, 240, 0.08); border-radius: 4px; padding: 32px; transition: transform 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1), border-color 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1); } .ds-card:hover { transform: translateY(-4px); border-color: rgba(255, 107, 53, 0.3); } .ds-card-header { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: flex-start; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 16px; margin-bottom: 16px; } .ds-card-title { font-family: 'Oswald', sans-serif; font-size: clamp(1.1rem, 2.5vw, 1.4rem); font-weight: 700; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.02em; color: #F5F5F0; margin: 0; line-height: 1.1; } .ds-card-meta { font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace; font-size: 0.85rem; color: #888888; } .ds-card-date { font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace; font-size: 0.75rem; padding: 5px 11px; background: rgba(255, 107, 53, 0.15); color: #FF6B35; border-radius: 4px; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-card-body { font-family: 'Source Serif 4', serif; font-size: 0.95rem; color: #888888; line-height: 1.6; max-width: 65ch; margin: 0; }

components.name: Print Button
components.description: Fixed floating button for PDF export. Forge Orange background, the only element with a shadow.
components.css: .ds-print-btn { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; padding: 12px 20px; background: #FF6B35; color: #0a0a0a; border: none; border-radius: 4px; font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace; font-size: 0.85rem; font-weight: 500; cursor: pointer; box-shadow: 0 4px 20px rgba(255, 107, 53, 0.3); transition: all 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1); } .ds-print-btn:hover { transform: translateY(-2px); box-shadow: 0 6px 30px rgba(255, 107, 53, 0.4); } .ds-print-btn:active { transform: translateY(0); }

components.name: Language Switcher
components.description: Fixed top-right language toggle. Carbon surface with ghost border.
components.html: EN/VI
components.css: .ds-lang { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace; font-size: 0.8rem; background: #141414; border: 1px solid rgba(245, 245, 240, 0.08); border-radius: 4px; padding: 6px 11px; } .ds-lang a { color: #888888; text-decoration: none; transition: color 0.2s ease; padding: 2px 3px; } .ds-lang a:hover { color: #F5F5F0; } .ds-lang-active { color: #FF6B35 !important; font-weight: 600; } .ds-lang-divider { color: #888888; opacity: 0.5; }

components.name: Date Badge
components.description: Inline time-period chip. Same visual family as tags but never interactive.
components.css: .ds-date { font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace; font-size: 0.75rem; text-transform: none; letter-spacing: 0; padding: 5px 11px; background: rgba(255, 107, 53, 0.15); color: #FF6B35; border-radius: 4px; white-space: nowrap; }

components.name: Contact Item
components.description: Hero contact detail. Label over value in a tonal surface card.
components.css: .ds-contact { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 4px; padding: 16px; background: #141414; border: 1px solid rgba(245, 245, 240, 0.08); border-radius: 4px; transition: border-color 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1); } .ds-contact:hover { border-color: rgba(255, 107, 53, 0.3); } .ds-contact-label { font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace; font-size: 0.7rem; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.08em; color: #888888; } .ds-contact-value { font-family: 'Source Serif 4', serif; font-size: 0.95rem; color: #F5F5F0; }

narrative.overview:
A dark work surface where every tool has its place and nothing is left out by accident. The charcoal ground absorbs distraction; Forge Orange marks what matters. Typography carries the weight: Oswald for structure and headings, Source Serif 4 for readable body text, JetBrains Mono for data and labels. Three voices, one conversation.

The system is deliberately restrained. Sections divide by thin hairline borders, not padded containers. Spacing follows a doubling scale (8, 16, 32, 64, 96, 128px) that creates clear rhythm without monotony. Interactive elements respond with small vertical shifts and border warmth, never with bounces or elastic curves. The page feels like a well-organized workbench at night: focused, warm at the edges, precise at the center.

This system explicitly rejects corporate resume templates, WordPress themes, LinkedIn PDF exports, generic section dividers, stock icons, and bento-grid layouts. If it looks like a template, it has failed.
keyCharacteristics: Dark tonal layering (three charcoal steps) with single warm accent
Editorial type pairing: condensed sans display, serif body, monospace labels
Flat surfaces with hairline borders; shadow reserved for floating elements only
Responsive and tactile: hover states lift, borders warm, tags invert
Print stylesheet inverts to light theme for ink efficiency

rules.name: The One Flame Rule
rules.body: Forge Orange is the only saturated color on the page. It appears on section headings, interactive highlights, and the print button. If a second saturated hue enters the palette, the restraint contract is broken.

rules.name: The Three Voices Rule
rules.body: Each font family has one job. Oswald heads, Source Serif reads, JetBrains labels. A heading set in Source Serif or a label set in Oswald means the hierarchy has collapsed.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Shadows are prohibited except on fixed floating elements. Cards, sections, and content blocks convey depth through background color steps and border opacity, never through drop shadows.

dos: Do use Forge Orange as the single saturated color. Section headings, tags, the print button, and the drop cap are its domain.
Do separate surfaces with tonal steps (Charcoal Base, Carbon Surface, Raised Carbon) and Ghost Border hairlines, never with shadows.
Do cap body text at 65ch and use Source Serif 4 for all readable paragraphs.
Do add subtle hover lift (2px to 4px) and border warmth on interactive elements. The system is responsive and tactile.
Do use the spacing doubling scale (8, 16, 32, 64, 96, 128px) for vertical rhythm.
Do hide the print button and language switcher in print mode, and switch the palette to light theme with darker Forge Orange (#D44A1A).
donts: Don't use a second saturated color. One flame only.
Don't apply drop shadows to cards or content sections. Shadows belong exclusively to the floating print button.
Don't use Oswald for body text or Source Serif 4 for headings. The three voices stay in their lanes.
Don't introduce bento grids, stock icons, or template-like section dividers. Anything that signals 'template' rather than 'bespoke' is prohibited.
Don't use pure white (#fff) or pure black (#000). Every neutral is tinted.
Don't use bounce or elastic easing curves. All motion uses cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1) or similar exponential ease-out.
Don't add decorative elements (ornaments, stock photos, background patterns) that do not convey information.
